# Contributing to Proj1

Thank you for contributing! Please follow these contribution guidelines for all pull requests:

## Pull Request Checklist & Structure

Every pull request must include:

1. **Summary of Changes**: High-level overview of what was added or fixed.
2. **What Changed**: Specific technical details of code changes.
3. **Before & After / Visual Attachments**: Screenshots (`screenshot.png`) demonstrating the UI functionality.
4. **Browser Testing**: Checkpoints confirming testing across target browsers and viewports.
5. **Quality Checks**: Confirmation that all build and test steps pass successfully.

### Standard PR Template

```markdown
## Pull Request Title

### Summary of Changes
- Summary of changes...

### What Changed
- Detail 1
- Detail 2

### Browser Testing & Checkpoints
- [x] Chromium / Chrome
- [x] Responsive / Mobile viewports

### App Preview
<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saidmuhammad1/proj1/<branch>/screenshot.png" alt="App Screenshot" width="600"/>
```
